content:
Sam: FYI — last night we had repeat tail-latency spikes in eu-west that look like progressive spillovers. Thinking of a low-friction gradient-throttling + evacuation protocol to defuse hotspots. Ping if you have immediate objections.
Maria: Can you attach the grafana panel or a quick summary?
Sam: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 — 00:45–01:30 window, 95th jumps ~2.5x and stays noisy for ~20m. Stack: shared slices on AZ1, heavy long-context batch traffic.
Raj: Looks like a slow ramp (not one-off) — +1 for token-bucket throttles per-tenant that scale down as latency climbs. Also suggest a tiered evacuation: soft drain -> warm dedicated pool -> hard move.
Olivia: Careful on warm dedicated pools — warmup p99 can be 400–800ms depending on model quantization. Need a cost cap and keepalive policy or we blow the monthly commit.
Maria: Proposed config snippet for experiment: ```yaml
evacuation:
  strategy: gradient
  soft_drain_threshold_ms: 120
  keepalive_minutes: 30
throttle:
  base_rate_rps: 300
  burst_tokens: 1500
  decay_window_minutes: 10
```
Raj: For routing order: local slice -> dedicated-warm -> regional-fallback. Also add an emergency quick-fallback that routes to a smaller-context variant (quantized) for the few tenants that cause bursty long-context loads.
Sam: Can infra-bot add a temporarily observable tag when a tenant hits soft_drain so we can correlate cost and quality?
infra-bot: added tag "evac:soft" to allocations for any tenant moved by the experiment. Will emit events to #incidents when hard moves happen.
Olivia: Also need a telemetry counter for warmup-induced token inflation so billing doesn't surprise customers. If we keepalive 30m but only use 5m of useful traffic we should account for that.
Raj: Agreed. Suggest starting with a 2-week A/B: 5% of tenants get gradient throttle + canary drains (keepalive 15m), measure p95 latency, token cost delta, and failed request rate. If p95 improves >30% with <10% cost delta we scale up.
Maria: I'll wire up the grafana panel and an alert rule for progressive spill (3 x p95 over 10m). Sam, can you create the experiment PR with the config and list of tenants?
Sam: On it. Will include rollback playbook (immediate revert and forced-fallback to regional small-context). Target rollout tomorrow 06:00 UTC low-traffic window.
Olivia: TL;DR — ok with experiment as long as cost guardrails, keepalive caps, and observability tags are in place.
Sam: Great, thanks. We'll post a short runbook in #eng-oncall before rollout. :thumbsup:
